we have utilized 1.6M instances for SFT, 20K instances

trainingCompute.value: Total FLOPs: 1.26×10^24 (32B), 4.23×10^23 (7.8B), 9.41×10^22 (2.4B); includes base pretraining plus reasoning fine-tuning

findings.text: The authors say EXAONE Deep is specialized for reasoning and recommend EXAONE 3.5 Instruct for wider real-world use cases.

source.quote:
for addressing a wider
range of real-world use cases, we strongly recommend utilizing the EXAONE 3.5 Instruct models [7, 8, 9], which are
optimized for practical application scenarios.

notes: Reasoning-capability technical report only: MATH-500, AIME 2024/2025, CSAT 2025, GPQA Diamond, LiveCodeBench, MMLU, MMLU-Pro. No safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias, or dangerous-capability section or numbers. License Appendix B has ethical-use restrictions for licensees; that is not a model safety evaluation. Skipped all capability benchmarks per pilot safety-only rule. Eval setup sets generation length to 32K tokens; treated as harness setting, not maxOutput. Published date 2025-03-16 is from metadata only; the PDF does not state a release date.
